patient_conditions: (patient_id, conditi.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c-1),0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_conditions WHERE patient_id IS NULL OR condition IS NULL) FROM (SELECT patient_id, condition, COUNT(*) c FROM patient_conditions GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) d

FK: patient_id in pregnancies/patient_co.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT patient_id FROM pregnancies UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM patient_conditions UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM encounters UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM claims UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM pharmacy_fills UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM rpm_readings UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM sdoh_screenings UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM transport_requests UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM telehealth_requests UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM lab_results) x WHERE patient_id IS NULL OR patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patients)

FK: patients.zip resolves to zip_codes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients WHERE zip IS NULL OR zip NOT IN (SELECT zip FROM zip_codes)

FK: provider ids (patients.panel_provide.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT panel_provider_id p FROM patients UNION ALL SELECT provider_id FROM encounters UNION ALL SELECT assigned_provider_id FROM pregnancies UNION ALL SELECT assigned_provider_id FROM patient_conditions) x WHERE p IS NOT NULL AND p NOT IN (SELECT provider_id FROM providers)

FK: provider_references.referenced_npi r.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider_references WHERE referenced_npi IS NULL OR referenced_npi NOT IN (SELECT npi FROM providers)

FK: claims.encounter_id -> encounters an.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE encounter_id IS NULL OR encounter_id NOT IN (SELECT encounter_id FROM encounters)) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rpm_readings WHERE enrollment_id IS NULL OR enrollment_id NOT IN (SELECT enrollment_id FROM rpm_enrollments))

FK: facility ids (transport destination,.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT destination_facility_id f FROM transport_requests UNION ALL SELECT delivering_facility_id FROM pregnancies UNION ALL SELECT facility_id FROM providers) x WHERE f IS NOT NULL AND f NOT IN (SELECT facility_id FROM facilities)

pregnancies: trimester in 1-3 and distan.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pregnancies WHERE trimester NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 3 OR trimester IS NULL OR distance_to_delivery_miles IS NULL OR distance_to_delivery_miles < 0

rpm_readings: received_at is null exactl.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rpm_readings WHERE (received_at IS NULL) <> (transmission_status = 'missing') OR transmission_status NOT IN ('received','missing')

rpm_readings: readings marked missing st.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rpm_readings WHERE received_at IS NULL AND value IS NOT NULL

encounters: ED delivery / birth-before-a.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM encounters WHERE source_encounter_type = 'ED_delivery_or_BBA' AND avoidable_ed

patients: connectivity_status disagrees.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients p JOIN zip_codes z ON z.zip = p.zip WHERE (p.connectivity_status = 'dead-zone') <> z.is_telehealth_dead_zone

zip/county: ZIPs whose patients span mor.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT zip FROM patients GROUP BY zip HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT county) > 1) x

enum: values outside the contract value.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_conditions WHERE condition NOT IN ('chf','copd','diabetes','hypertension','behavioral_health')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM encounters WHERE encounter_type NOT IN ('ed','inpatient','in_person','telehealth')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider_references WHERE record_type NOT IN ('encounter','order','pending_claim'))

dates: no event dated after the data as-.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM encounters WHERE encounter_date > DATE '2026-05-15') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pharmacy_fills WHERE fill_date > DATE '2026-05-15') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rpm_readings WHERE expected_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-05-16 00:00:00') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_results WHERE result_date > DATE '2026-05-15')
